notes.claim: If a > 0 the parabola opens upward; if a < 0 it opens downward.
The y-intercept of any parabola y = ax² + bx + c is the point (0, c).
A parabola's graph is a U-shaped curve, and the quadratic's turning point can be read from its completed-square form.
The maximum height of a parabola sits in the middle of its two roots.
